snippet.title: España es un país en decadencia. Aquí está el por qué - @SoloFonseca
snippet.description:
Un recorrido completo por la historia económica y política de España desde los primeros años del franquismo hasta la actualidad. Analizamos cómo la autarquía, el estraperlo y las políticas intervencionistas dieron paso a las reformas tecnocráticas del Plan de Estabilización de 1959, la apertura al turismo y el posterior proceso de Transición e integración europea bajo gobiernos de distinto signo.   

También repasamos el auge del crédito y el ladrillo antes de 2008, el impacto del estallido de la crisis financiera, el Plan E, las subidas de impuestos, el rescate bancario y la evolución de la deuda pública. Finalmente, examinamos por qué hoy conviven un sistema de pensiones y empleo público con un mercado laboral tensionado, altos costes de vivienda y una pérdida de poder adquisitivo que afecta de lleno a las nuevas generaciones.

snippet.title: What If You Earned 1$ Every Quectosecond?
snippet.description:
What If You Got Paid $1 Every Quectosecond?
I Got $1 Every Quectosecond (Richest in the Universe Before Breakfast)

DESCRIPTION
One dollar doesn't sound like much. But a quectosecond is the smallest unit of time in the entire metric system: a millionth of a millionth of a millionth of a millionth of a millionth of a second. Get paid one dollar for every one of them, and you make a nonillion dollars every single second.

You're a millionaire after one yoctosecond. You pass the richest person on Earth faster than light can cross an atom. You're the richest person in the history of the universe before you even get out of bed. Then your bank app crashes, the bank calls, your thumb slips and you send your mom a quadrillion dollars, the government shows up to beg you to stop spending, and if your money were cash, it would collapse into a black hole made entirely of dollar bills.

But there's one thing you still can't afford.

If you earned a dollar every quectosecond, what's the first thing you'd buy? And what would you spend your time on? Tell me in the comments.

문 닫는 날, 코트 차림의 손님이 구두 열다섯 켤레를 내려놓고 말합니다.
"뒷굽 갈고 광까지요. 새벽 여섯 시에 옵니다."

이름도, 전화번호도 남기지 않은 손님.
옆 세탁소 최 사장은 "안 찾아가면 어쩌려고" 말리지만
일흔둘 박 사장은 성치 않은 손목으로 밤새 망치를 듭니다.

그런데 한 켤레를 손질하던 박 사장의 손이 멈춥니다.
"옛날에 내가 덧댄 박음질인데…"

약속한 새벽 여섯 시가 지나도 손님은 오지 않습니다.

평생 남의 구두를 고쳐 온 구두 수선 장인과
마지막 날까지 가게를 지키는 모든 사장님께 드리는 이야기입니다.

차 한 잔 놓고 편히 쉬었다 가세요.

snippet.title: Nuclear watchdog sounds new Zaporizhzhia alert | BBC News
snippet.description:
Ukraine's President Zelensky has expressed deep frustration with the US, saying it is not pushing Russia hard enough in talks to end Europe's bloodiest conflict since the Second World War. He told the BBC that he found it 'strange', to hear President Trump describe Russia's Vladimir Putin as his 'friend' during talks in China last week but President Trump says he told Putin he was his friend because he wants to get deal on Ukraine.
 
European Union leaders defer budget negotiations after tensions surfaced over the bloc's spending priorities and aid for Ukraine, while elsewhere the International Atomic Energy Agency has said it is working with both Russia and Ukraine to try to arrange a ninth localised ceasefire at the Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant . It follows another loss of power, apparently due to military activity.

snippet.title: How a US-British Invasion of Italy Almost Failed
snippet.description:
In September 1943 the first American invasion of mainland Europe nearly ended in the sea. At Salerno, German tanks broke through to
within five miles of the beach, and General Mark Clark had his staff plan to take the Americans off their beaches. What stopped them?
The artillery at the river junction, paratroopers dropped into the beachhead, the guns of Allied cruisers and battleships, the air
forces, and the British Eighth Army closing in from the south: in the German commander's own words.

On one map: the US VI Corps and the British 10 Corps landing on 9 September 1943, the gap between them along the Sele River, the
German counterattack of 13 September down the Sele-Calore corridor, and the beachhead holding. Two original US Army maps from the
official history, laid on today's satellite.

Sources:
- Martin Blumenson, Salerno to Cassino (US Army in World War II, Center of Military History, 1969), ch. VI-X and Maps I and 2
- Rick Atkinson, The Day of Battle (2007)
- C. J. C. Molony, The Mediterranean and Middle East, vol. V (HMSO, 1973)
- Samuel Eliot Morison, Sicily-Salerno-Anzio (History of US Naval Operations in WWII, vol. IX, 1954)
- Robert M. Citino, "The US Invasion of Italy", The National WWII Museum
Casualty figures (killed, wounded or missing, the battle of the beachhead, 9-18 Sept.): Blumenson ch. IX (about 3,500 US, 5,500
British, 3,500 German); for the whole operation to 6 Oct. the Allied figure is higher.

Maps and imagery: US Army maps "Fifth Army Landings, 9-13 September 1943" and "The VI Corps Holds, 13-14 September 1943" (Blumenson
1969, public domain); photographs: US Army / NARA 531170 (Paestum, 22 Sept. 1943), US Army (Mark W. Clark), Truman Library 72-901
(Kesselring), Polish National Digital Archives 2-2077 (Kesselring and Vietinghoff, 1944), IWM E 16458 (Alexander) and E 18980
(Montgomery). Satellite: NASA Blue Marble; Sentinel-2 cloudless - https://s2maps.eu by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus
Sentinel data 2016). Elevation: SRTM (NASA, USGS) via AWS Terrain Tiles. Coast, rivers and towns: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

Music: "Clash Defiant" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0
(creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). J. S. Bach, Air (Orchestral Suite No. 3), performed by the US Air Force Strings (public domain).

snippet.title: Come togliere le persone da una foto senza AI
snippet.description:
Una foto sola non basta: qui ne servono 60.

Plaza de España, Siviglia, una domenica alle 16:30. Nikon Z6 + 24-70 f/4 a 31 mm su treppiede.

Tutto bloccato, così le 60 foto sono identiche tranne la gente: M, f/8, 1/250, ISO 100, fuoco manuale, bilanciamento del bianco su "Sole". Uno scatto ogni 8 secondi, con l'otturatore elettronico.

In Photoshop: File → Script → Statistiche → Mediana, con "Tenta di allineare automaticamente le immagini sorgente" spuntato. Gratis lo fa anche Affinity (New Stack → Median).

La mia l'ho calcolata con uno script, il conto è lo stesso. Dove passava troppa gente restava un'ombra: lì ho preso il pezzo da uno scatto solo. Nessun pixel inventato.

Tu le avresti tolte?

snippet.title: Zaryab finds Hamna's diary 📔.  #darenijaat #shorts #drama #viral #trending #dramashorts
snippet.description:
Late at night, Zaryab approaches Abu Bakar's mother. Noticing that something is troubling her, she gently asks, "Beta, kya hua? Do you need anything?"

Zaryab replies with a little hesitation, "No, Ammi. I am just feeling scared sleeping alone in that room. Can I sleep beside you tonight?"

Abu Bakar's mother lovingly replies, "Of course, beta. You can sleep here whenever you want."

She then asks, "Beta, would you like to talk to Zaryab?"

Abu bakar immediately refuses and says, "No, Ammi. I will talk to him tomorrow."

While looking around, Zaryab suddenly comes across Hamna's diary. Out of curiosity, she starts reading it. But what she discovers leaves her completely shocked. Inside the diary, she finds a photograph of Abu Bakar and Hamna together. For a moment, she cannot believe what she is seeing.

She starts thinking to herself, "So, this is the real twist of the story! Abu Bakar also has his own flaws and hidden secrets. And Hamna... she is just like me. She was also crazy in love with Abu Bakar, just as I once was for Zamil. It seems that for some men, a woman's feelings are nothing more than a toy. Whether it is Zamil or Abu Bakar, both have their own stories, and both have left women struggling with their emotions."

Meanwhile, Zamil is sitting somewhere far away, constantly looking at Zaryab's photograph. Even though he is now away from her, he cannot stop thinking about her. He is so lost in his memories that he barely pays attention to his wife, Hamna.

Hamna notices his silence and asks, "Why aren't you saying anything? Is something bothering you?"

Zamil simply replies, "You speak. I am listening."

But his words are empty because his mind is somewhere else. Feeling ignored and hurt, Hamna eventually ends the phone call.

On the other hand, Zaryab wonders whether Zamil has already reached Boston. She thinks to herself, "Perhaps he has gone to Boston by now. I wonder if he is thinking about me or if he even remembers me."

Seeing Zaryab lost in her thoughts, Abu Bakar's mother gently asks, "Zaryab, are you missing your family?"

Zaryab quietly replies, "No, I am missing Zamil."

Her honest answer surprises no one more than herself. She then asks Abu Bakar's mother, "Ammi, don't you feel bad that I am still remembering Zamil even after coming here?"

Abu Bakar's mother responds with understanding, "No, beta. A girl cannot forget her past so easily. Memories and emotions take time to fade. Everyone has a story, and nobody can erase their feelings just because life has taken a different turn."

Zaryab becomes emotional and admits, "But I feel that I will never be able to forget Zamil."

And perhaps this is the biggest truth of life: Sometimes, we believe we understand ourselves and our feelings completely, but life has a different plan. We become so confident about our future, our relationships, and the people we love that we forget how unpredictable life can be.

snippet.title: Bir Hamburgercinin Stratejik Zekası 🧠😱
snippet.description:
İnanılmaz bir lezzet! 🍔 oktoistanbul Reklam. Moda’nın ara sokaklarında, şefinin de garsonunun da kuryesinin de işletme sahibinin de aynı kişi olduğu, tamamen emek üzerine kurulmuş butik bir burgerci keşfettim.

Brioche ekmeklerinden özel soslarına, limonatalarına kadar her şeyi kendileri hazırlıyorlar. Mutfağı tertemiz, malzeme kalitesi ve lezzet dengesi gerçekten çok başarılı. Bugüne kadar yediğim en iyi hamburgerler arasına kesinlikle girdi.

🍔 Ben imza lezzetleri olan isli Çerkez peynirli ve mantar soslu Okto Burger’i, glutensiz burger alternatifini, ızgara hellim peynirli Halloumi Burger’i ve el yapımı limonatalarını denedim.

💸 Menü fiyatları:

• Okto Burger: 469 TL
• Truffle Burger: 459 TL
• Halloumi Burger: 489 TL
• Dobi Burger: 499 TL
• Chili Chick: 389 TL
• Smoky Rib Kaburga Burger: 689 TL
• Trüflü ve parmesanlı patates: 189 TL
• El yapımı limonata: 105 TL

Bazen büyük restoranların sunamadığı lezzeti, işini tutkuyla yapan birinin küçücük dükkânında buluyorsunuz. Burası tam olarak öyle bir yer. Böyle emek veren işletmelerin çok daha fazla insan tarafından keşfedilmesi gerektiğini düşünüyorum.

Hamburger seviyorsanız mutlaka deneyin. Bayılacaksınız!

📍OKTO BURGER - Caferağa Mahallesi, Ağabey Sokak No: 4, 34710 Kadıköy/İstanbul
⏰ Her gün 12.00 - 23.30

snippet.title: 러시아 급소에 '치명타' 날린 우크라...푸틴 결국 "상황 어렵다" 인정 [에디터픽] / YTN
snippet.description:
우크라이나의 계속된 에너지 시설 공격으로 러시아의 연료난이 심화하고 있습니다.

알렉산드르 노박 러시아 부총리는 현지 시간 25일 "여러 정유시설이 수리 중으로, 연료 시장 상황이 긴박하다"며 휘발유 수출 금지 조치를 내년 1월 이후로 연장하는 방안을 다음 달 검토할 것이라고 밝혔습니다.

러우전쟁 관련 주요 뉴스를 모아서 전해드립니다.

1. "상황 어렵다" 고개 숙인 러시아…푸틴 한계 폭발 [지금이뉴스] (261126)
2. 러시아, 유럽에 핵 위협...미국 "푸틴이 참고 있다" (261127 신웅진 기자)
3. 트럼프·나토 수장, 러시아에 "우크라이나 전쟁 확전 말라" (261127 이승윤 기자)
4. 러, 우크라 공세에 "연료시장 상황 긴박...수출 금지 연장 검토" (261126 조수현 기자)
5. 우크라에 급소 찔린 푸틴 '뼈 아픈 상황'…대대적 보복 경고 [지금이뉴스] (261125)
6. 독일 총리 "2008년 우크라 나토 가입 막은 건 실수" (261124 조수현 기자)
7. 우크라, 지중해까지 전선 확대...러, 수도권 맹폭 (261124 조수현 기자)
8. 러, 에스토니아 대사대리 불러 국경폐쇄 항의 (261124 조수현 기자)
9. "리비아 항구서 러시아 군함 피격...우크라 공격 추정" (261123 조수현 기자)
10. 푸틴 한 명 살리겠다고…위태로운 러시아 전역 [지금이뉴스] (261111)
11. "우크라이나전 러시아 사망자 45만 명...러 통계청 자료 유출" (261113 조수현 기자)
12. 불가리아 흑해 연안서 이틀 연속 화물선 침몰 (261117 조수현 기자)
